benefit: Mammoth sunflower borders draw pollinators and beneficials away from the corn block while providing late-season seed for birds. Use as a trap planting for stink bugs.

members.title: Sunflower border, 1 week before corn
members.body: Direct-sow sunflowers on the windward border one week before corn planting. Spacing 12 to 18 inches in a single row.
